Features
ASCII Matrix

ASCII Matrix

The ASCII Matrix renders a full-canvas grid of characters over the gradient layer. Characters respond to mouse proximity in real time — brightening, shifting, or decaying based on where the cursor moves — creating a dynamic, interactive typographic texture.

The matrix runs on a separate canvas layer composited over the WebGL output, keeping it visually controllable without affecting the underlying gradient animation.

CharsetCharactersCharacter

CustomYour textBrand name, keyword, any string

Custom Charset

Enter any text in the custom field — a brand name, a phrase, a single repeated character — and the matrix tiles it across the canvas. Combined with a large font size, this is an effective way to embed text as texture.

Mouse Interaction

Move the cursor over the canvas to activate the heatmap. Characters within the Interaction Radius respond with increased brightness and animation activity.

ParameterEffect
RadiusSize of the interaction zone around the cursor
DecayHow quickly characters return to their resting state after the cursor leaves
SmoothEasing on the interaction response — higher values produce a softer, more gradual activation
GravityPulls activated characters toward the cursor; at 0 characters stay in place

Display Controls

ParameterEffect
SizeFont size of each character cell
SpacingLine-height multiplier — tighter values pack characters closer vertically
FontSelects from a set of monospaced typefaces
ColorThe fill color of the characters
Blend ModeHow the character layer composites over the gradient

Blend Modes

Blend ModeEffect
OverlayCharacters take on the gradient's hue — natural integration
ScreenCharacters always lighten — works well on dark gradients
MultiplyCharacters always darken — works well on light gradients
NormalFlat character color over the gradient, no blending

Interaction Mode

ModeDescription
Heatmap DecayCharacters brighten on cursor contact, then fade back — decay leaves a glowing trail
Dynamic BackgroundThe full character grid animates continuously; cursor interaction shifts character density
💡

For landing page hero sections, try Code charset at a medium size with Overlay blend and a 20% decay — it creates a living background texture that doesn't compete with foreground text.
